Exact equality in the T2 bound occurs iff each shift has at most one nonzero weight: the cyclic bidiagonal support graph has no 4-cycles, and any rank-one grade block has all entries in one row or column. This includes genuinely nonnormal A²,B² and near-rank-one factors outside earlier sufficient regions; strict T2 dual gap when either shift has at least two nonzero weights.
